content.title: Practice Any Script, Anywhere
content.subtitle: A self-serve guide to PresentPro's rehearsal, coaching, and AI tools
content.audience: Potential users reaching this via a bookmarked link, async, self-serve

slides.title: One surface, from first draft to final rehearsal
items: Start — paste a script, or record one blind
Report — score, filler words, pace, downloadable recording
slides.cap: No signup, no install, to start.

slides.title: Two ways to arrive stage-ready
items: Already have a script: rehearse against live pace/filler tracking, download, re-listen, loop in AI coaching
Starting from nothing: blind-rehearse, capture the transcript, get an AI rewrite into a real script

chart.insight: Both entry points feed the same rehearse -> review -> AI-coach loop, and either one ends with a script ready to practice anywhere.

slides.title: Four ways the tools meet you where you are
items: In the browser: full teleprompter, webcam, session recording
Chrome extension: docked popup window beside whatever you're working on
On mobile: teleprompter text scales down for a commute or the gym
AI coaching loop: one-click prompt pre-filled with script + transcript

slides.title: What changes when the tool does the watching
items: Feedback on delivery: guessing vs. live pace/filler/pause tracking
Reviewing yourself: no record vs. a downloadable take to re-listen to
No script yet: a blank page vs. blind rehearsal + AI rewrite
Where you can rehearse: wherever you can prop up a laptop vs. desktop, docked panel, or phone
A second opinion: scheduling a coach vs. an AI coaching prompt any time
